notes.text: Picked up for day center on time; no issues during transport.
Garland attended day center, joined chair exercise and music group, and ate most of lunch.
Garland enjoyed the gardening group and talked about growing tomatoes as a child.
Chronic conditions reviewed and stable. Continue current plan.

Met with Linda, Garland's son and primary caregiver. Linda reports exhaustion and poor sleep, and is worried about managing evenings alone. Requests respite. Discussed respite options and caregiver support group.
Routine check. Vitals within his usual range. Medications taken as directed. No new concerns.
Assisted with light housekeeping and meal prep. Garland in good spirits.

Linda reports Garland has been more confused in the evenings for about two weeks, once leaving the stove on. Oriented to person and place today but not date. No fever. Plan: urinalysis, medication review, and PCP visit this week.

Seen at partner hospital emergency department on Nov 5, 2026 for chest pain; cardiac workup negative; admitted for 3 days. No new medications at discharge. Follow up with PACE primary care within 7 days.
Post-hospital follow-up for chest pain; cardiac workup negative. Garland is back to baseline per his son. Reviewed discharge medications. Will monitor closely over the next two weeks.
